description: This file defines a utility object 'DimenParseUtils' with a method to safely parse string representations of dimensions into integers, returning null for invalid inputs.

classes.name: DimenParseUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions for parsing dimension strings into integers without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: parseIntOrNull
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string or returns null if the input is null, blank, or not a valid number.
